ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; macro-level ratio characterized by a dominant high-intensity white central field (approximately 70% of visible surface) bordered by low-intensity black perimeter and peduncle regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white central blobs on both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation mapped to the distal tips, trailing edge margins, and a dense central cluster near the peduncle with radiating dark streaks extending toward the mid-lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch; approximate 105-degree pixel angle; vertex depth partially obscured by water spray pixels at the base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations localized on the distal 15% of the right lobe; minor irregular scalloping visible along the left lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges, sweeping from the central notch upward to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, dark-toned pixels at the extreme distal tips and leading edges, consistent with parasitic attachment sites or barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed across both white lobes, predominantly oriented diagonally from the trailing edge toward the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive multi-directional linear rake marks across the ventral surface; slight irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical 'brush-stroke' dark pigmentation pattern radiating from the peduncle junction into the white fields of the fluke lobes.
